Playbook.name: CORE — New Database Principal Accessing Core Banking - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A database principal not seen before (new_terms, type CORE_AuditTrail) accessed the core banking system. Triage: a new/compromised principal accessing core banking, or a legitimately-onboarded account?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A new principal in core banking may be a compromised or attacker-provisioned account with access to financial data.

LogSources.LogSource: Core banking audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Core banking audit in apps-* (type CORE_AuditTrail). Principal is USERNAME.

Signal.Name: New Database Principal Accessing Core Ba

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the new core-banking principal is compromised/rogue or a legitimate new account.

Step.name: The new principal's core-banking activity
Step.Purpose: What the new principal accessed/did in core banking sets the risk.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE type == "CORE_AuditTrail" AND USERNAME == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), actions = VALUES(ACTION_NAME) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: A new principal performing sensitive core-banking operations (financial transactions, data access) with no onboarding record is high-risk. A newly-onboarded teller/officer performing expected work is benign.

Node.Condition: A new principal performing sensitive core-banking operations with no onboarding record.
Node.Result: True Positive (Rogue/Compromised Core Account - escalate, disable)

Node.Condition: An integration using a new service account (baseline gap).

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-CORE-ACTIVITY to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm onboarding; baseline; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: A rogue or compromised core-banking account.

SOCAction.Item: Disable the account; review the operations/data accessed; open IR; escalate to fraud/compliance.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An integration using an unbaselined account.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the principal and operations; confirm onboarding.
If rogue, disable and review data accessed.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Disable the account; review operations/data; open IR; escalate to fraud/compliance.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Govern core-banking account onboarding; alert on new principals; least-privilege.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Rogue account disabled; data reviewed; fraud/compliance engaged.
